title: Extract deployment data with jq
task: From deploy.json, write the names of enabled services to enabled.txt in array order. Then write the enabled names and ports to ports.tsv, separated by literal tabs.
hints: Inspect the top-level object with jq . deploy.json.
Use .name for the first report and [.name, .port] | @tsv for the second.

checks.label: Only enabled service names appear
checks.feedback: Use the enabled boolean and preserve array order.

checks.label: The enabled names and ports form TSV rows
checks.feedback: Build [name, port] and apply @tsv with jq -r.

demo.explanation: Build a row as an array and format it with @tsv.
